evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/clm-s732/<planId>/ with gate runs under tmp/clm-s732/<planId>/final/. Before repeating a gate run, move final/ to attempt-<n>/. Retry loops write <name>-1.log..<name>-3.log and copy the green attempt to <name>.log. tmp/ holds only .log, .txt, .json and .jsonl data, never binaries, .ts files or .cpuprofile files, and at most 300 files per plan. CPU profiles go to target/clm-s732-profile/. Cargo output goes to target/ (artifactRoots ["target"] in every plan); target/clm-baseline/nodetto-cli is the pre-change baseline binary and must never be deleted (no cargo clean).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: clm-02 passes scoped stores to the unchanged planners instead of editing each planner.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Bounds every planner at once and keeps command order as a filtered subsequence, guarded by byte-identical expected files.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The first apply, and any apply after a change made outside apply, covers the whole document.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: applyBatch does not reconcile, and the HEAD first apply normalizes stale derived values on every page. One pass per batch preserves byte identity; it is not per-operation work.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A dirty page with any cross-page link widens the apply to the whole document.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Superset of the design's cross-page cases; widening more is always safe and equals today's cost.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: clm-11 is in wave 2 only because it calls keepMembers from clm-02.
clm-12 keeps units inside their pool for the unit-under-non-leaf-lane and unit-under-pool-with-lanes cases, and carries units of collapsed pools with the pool.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: HEAD sends them to the free row, which contradicts the design's 'units end inside their own row'.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: BPMN layered applies containerCommands then unitCommands.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: planBpmnTranslations carries descendants whose positions a command did not change; two applies avoid a keepMembers dependency.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: BatchResult.matches is optional; clm-09 adds the one passthrough line in apply-batch.ts.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: apply-batch.ts is owned by clm-02 in wave 1.

intentionalTradeoffs: A page with cross-page links keeps today's cost when edited, in exchange for a simple and safe widening rule.
deleteElements and deletePage still materialize the whole working map for that one command, because the reference closure may cross pages.
A single wiring plan (clm-09) owns all shared registration files, so feature modules import new core symbols by relative path until wiring lands.
The BPMN flow label box uses estimated text metrics.
If the A7 1.5x CPU target is not reached after profiling, clm-02 reports it as blocked with the remaining cost instead of marking itself done.
supportedEdgeCases: Multi-page documents where an unrelated page holds 600 nodes and 300 obstacle-avoiding connectors (multiPage and mixedMultiPage fixtures).
Stale derived values on an untouched page are normalized once by the first apply, as at HEAD; undo followed by an apply repeats the whole-document pass.

carryMembers:false on move and resize for frames, pools, lanes (height only), sub-processes and boards; group and non-container targets are rejected with fixed errors; boundary events stay on their host.
BPMN layered: nested lanes, collapsed pools, free row with and without pools, sub-processes, boundary events, message flows, idempotent rerun.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Layered and route arrange for sequence, breadboard and pcb pages (excluded, with the reasons documented in clm-09 help).
Speedups for edits on pages with cross-page links (they keep today's cost).
Changing existing defaults (frame carry, tidy, overlaps, edit --arrange, BPMN label rendering without labelPosition).
Server, auth or deployment code; pushes, tags, releases.
residualRisks: Batch-level O(document) work (parse, final validate, serialize) is not per-operation and may keep the native multi-page ratio above 1.5x even with planners bounded; clm-02 then reports the remaining cost.
Dirty-page scoping depends on a complete cross-page link audit; byte-identical expected files and per-case tests guard it.
Native deadline tests may fail under load after 3 attempts; deadlines are never relaxed.
mise run verify may rewrite tracked apps/desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas/*.json; commits stage explicit paths only.
